title: tk sandbox worker-prompt's template still lacks the headless and no-amend lines tick 060 added to the cloud role prompts
description:
The shared worker template behind `tk sandbox worker-prompt` (ticks' internal/herd/spawn BuildPrompt) carries neither the "ending your turn ends the job / never wait on a background task" line nor the "do not amend, rebase or reset commits you have already made" line. ticfac's cloud role prompts now carry both, so factory-dispatched workers (TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT, which wins verbatim) get them — but a cloud worker booted by hand, or dispatched by a factory that predates the role-prompt field, falls back to the checkout-rendered prompt and still runs without them.

Filed by ticfac run epic-6in of pengelbrecht/ticfac from the finding feef02ff40620e82d3e719d7f1ef61b9b2818dd11d24bf34eac8eb7f48f08d01 (upstream-tick, severity low), reported by run-epic-6in/tick-060/attempt-1. The finding was routed to this repository; the run that found it cannot fix another repository, so it filed it here rather than hold its own epic on it.
